title: REPORT on the Council position on the draft general budget of the European Union for the financial year 2027
part_text: 3. Welcomes the Council’s prudent budgetary approach and supports targeted reductions in appropriations where these help better align spending with actual implementation needs; emphasises the need to control non-priority spending and avoid any unjustified increases in appropriations, in order to preserve sufficient margins below the MFF ceilings and to focus available resources on key priorities such as agriculture, security, and border protection;
